page_title: DAR 2-2 EIN | Darmstadt v Eintracht Frankfurt 20/01/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' That's it for today, Daniel Siebert has blown his whistle and the game is over.

90+5' 2 - 2 GOAL! Superb work from Tobias Kempe, who plays a vital role in the build-up. He squares it to Christoph Klarer (Darmstadt), who beats Kevin Trapp with a brilliant shot into the left side of the net. 2:2.
90+3' Here is a change. Mario Gotze is going off and Dino Toppmoller gives the last tactical orders to Hrvoje Smolcic (Eintracht Frankfurt).
90+3' Substitution. Junior Dina Ebimbe did his best and is replaced by Sebastian Rode (Eintracht Frankfurt).
90+1' Luca Pfeiffer (Darmstadt) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
90+1' Junior Dina Ebimbe (Eintracht Frankfurt) finds space inside the box but rifles his effort miles past the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Darmstadt.
90' 7 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' Dino Toppmoller has decided to make a change. Jens Petter Hauge (Eintracht Frankfurt) replaces Ansgar Knauff.
89' Substitution. Sasa Kalajdzic will be replaced by Jessic Ngankam (Eintracht Frankfurt).
89' A substitution has been made. Fabian Holland is replaced by Christoph Zimmermann (Darmstadt).

86' Fabian Holland (Darmstadt) comes close to scoring! He gets the ball inside the box from the resulting corner but his shot flies just over the crossbar. This should be a big warning for the defence. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Eintracht Frankfurt.
86' The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Darmstadt.
85' Luca Pfeiffer (Darmstadt) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders. Darmstadt have a corner.
80' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Fabian Nurnberger leaves the pitch and Emir Karic (Darmstadt) comes on.
80' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Tobias Kempe (Darmstadt) comes onto the pitch so that Bartol Franjic can be given a rest.
79' Torsten Lieberknecht decides to make a substitution. Tim Skarke will be replaced by Oscar Vilhelmsson (Darmstadt).
78' Fabian Holland (Darmstadt) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
77' Bartol Franjic (Darmstadt) is penalised for a foul. Daniel Siebert had a clear view and blows his whistle.
75' Eintracht Frankfurt are seeing far more of the ball now.
73' Corner kicks – 3:1.
70' Kevin Trapp (Eintracht Frankfurt) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
70' Kevin Trapp (Eintracht Frankfurt) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
68' Buta (Eintracht Frankfurt) sees a yellow card from Daniel Siebert after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
64' The substitution has been made. Buta (Eintracht Frankfurt) has replaced Donny van de Beek.
62' 1 - 2 Goal! Julian Justvan (Darmstadt) pounced on a loose ball inside the box and beats the goalkeeper with a shot into the bottom left corner. He makes it 1:2.
61' Kevin Trapp (Eintracht Frankfurt) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
59' Kevin Trapp (Eintracht Frankfurt) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.

58' Excellent touch by Tim Skarke (Darmstadt)! He latches on to a precise pass on the edge of the box and produces a shot goalwards which goes way wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Eintracht Frankfurt will have a goal kick.
54' The resulting set piece from Darmstadt is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

54' Luca Pfeiffer (Darmstadt) runs with the ball towards the keeper and pulls the trigger from close range, but Kevin Trapp anticipates his intention and makes an amazing save to stop the shot going into the middle of the target.
51' 0 - 2 Goal! Ansgar Knauff (Eintracht Frankfurt) fires home from very close range after latching on to a pass from Sasa Kalajdzic. The score is 0:2.

50' Eintracht Frankfurt hold possession of the ball and display neat passing from player to player. They are waiting for the right moment to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
49' Handball by Tim Skarke (Darmstadt).
46' Torsten Lieberknecht has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Andreas Muller (Darmstadt) comes on the pitch for Matej Maglica.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+3' The match has reached half-time.

45+1' Luca Pfeiffer (Darmstadt) lets fly with a decent effort from the edge of the box that flashes just wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Eintracht Frankfurt.
45' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.
44' Sasa Kalajdzic (Eintracht Frankfurt) commits a rough foul. Daniel Siebert stops the game and makes a call. A free kick has been awarded to Darmstadt.
42' A corner kick by Darmstadt is thwarted by the well prepared Kevin Trapp (Eintracht Frankfurt).
42' Matthias Bader (Darmstadt) has a shot blocked from inside the box. The ball is out of play and Darmstadt manage to earn a corner.

40' A clever short pass gives Ansgar Knauff (Eintracht Frankfurt) a clear goal scoring opportunity, but he fluffs his lines and rifles the ball well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Darmstadt will have a goal kick.
38' Luca Pfeiffer (Darmstadt) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.
37' Matej Maglica (Darmstadt) is able to continue to play.
36' Matej Maglica (Darmstadt) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
36' Darmstadt can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
33' 0 - 1 Goal - 0:1! Junior Dina Ebimbe laid the ball off to Niels Nkounkou (Eintracht Frankfurt), who shot from close range into the right side of the goal, leaving the goalkeeper helpless.
32' Hugo Larsson (Eintracht Frankfurt) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Daniel Siebert saw the whole situation.
29' Tim Skarke (Darmstadt) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
28' The Eintracht Frankfurt players are exchanging some short passes.
23' The current number of shots on goal is 0:2.
21' Eintracht Frankfurt are showcasing great team work and neat passing moves.
19' A yellow card for a tackle by Matej Maglica (Darmstadt). Daniel Siebert doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
16' Niels Nkounkou (Eintracht Frankfurt) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.

14' Niels Nkounkou (Eintracht Frankfurt) doesn't hesitate and begins a run towards the opponent's goal. Defenders try to tackle him, but he manages to keep the ball at his feet and pulls the trigger in front of the goal. The strike, though, was not as successful as the solo run and the ball is easily stopped by the keeper.

11' Junior Dina Ebimbe (Eintracht Frankfurt) makes a rough challenge and Daniel Siebert blows his whistle for a foul. Darmstadt win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
10' Some great controlled play and passing from Eintracht Frankfurt. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
7' Donny van de Beek (Eintracht Frankfurt) is caught offside!
7' Junior Dina Ebimbe (Eintracht Frankfurt) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders.
6' One of the players from Darmstadt times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
5' Darmstadt are showing great team chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly.

3' Niels Nkounkou (Eintracht Frankfurt) steadies himself and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the left side of the goal, but Marcel Schuhen has it covered and makes a comfortable save.
2' Donny van de Beek (Eintracht Frankfurt) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.
1' The first half has started.
Darmstadt will kick-off.
Daniel Siebert is introduced as the referee for today's match.
